sourceUnits.zh: 其年皝伐高句麗，王釗乞盟而還。
sourceUnits.en: That year he invaded Goguryeo; King Gao Zhao sued for peace and he withdrew.
sourceUnits.literal: That year Huang campaigned against Gaogouli; King Gao Zhao begged a covenant, and Huang returned.

sourceUnits.zh: 明年，釗遣其世子朝於皝。
sourceUnits.en: The next year Gao Zhao sent his heir to pay homage to Huang.
sourceUnits.literal: The next year, Zhao sent his heir apparent to court at Huang.
